lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Weakling,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: you should stop joking around.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The sheer incompetence of your commanding back there was stunning.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You got a whole bunch of our comrades killed.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Hey, are you listening to me?
I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You think apologizing will make this all better?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You're a Commander, so do your job.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Why did you insist on a frontal assault?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If you bothered to assess our strength against the enemy's,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: you'd have realized that a head-on encounter was nothing short of suicidal.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You should have ordered the rear support to retreat

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: and had the vanguards in the 1st unit draw their attention.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You have to be able to think on your feet and make proper judgments.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's your duty, a burden you bear alone.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I don't care if you're a human,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: that's no excuse for screwing up like you did.
I thought we could win with the team we had.
I trusted my judgment, and it turns out I was wrong.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I thought as much.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Anyway, we could sit here all night dissecting what went wrong,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but it won't bring back our dead comrades.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Have you been brainwashed by those idiots around you?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You were behaving like a mindless drone.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You moron...
I would defend myself... but you're right.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I never thought you could be this incompetent.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: That was a battle we could have won.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You alone serve as undeniable evidence that when the Commander lacks competence,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: everything else becomes futile.
I'm sorry about losing the battle, but...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What? After such an ignominious defeat, what could you possibly have to say for yourself?
Why are you getting so angry over a PvP match?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Say that again. I dare you.
Never mind.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I couldn't care less whether the battle is real or simulated.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Victory is inevitable for me in every single one,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: and don't you ever forget that.
Noted.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Good. Now, if you think you can handle it,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: let's play another match.
